final.narration: This gauge is worth watching. Recent field measurements show river flow running about 11% lower than the published rating predicts, which sits outside the site's normal 8% scatter. Because data quality and visit frequency remain solid, no specific malfunction or rating shift has been identified, and the record remains generally dependable. Continue using the published flow data for regular operations, but keep an eye on the next routine field inspection to see if this modest difference persists. Trust score 91/100 (Trusted).

deductions.name: residual
deductions.reason: Recent measurements carry 11.1 % less water than the rating predicts (median of 8); this gauge's normal scatter is 8.0 %, so 3.1 % is excess at 2 points per % (cap 50).

deductions.name: staleness
deductions.reason: Last field measurement was 22 days ago; deductions start after 90 days and reach 20 at 365.

deductions.name: quality
deductions.reason: Recent measurements rated 5 Fair, 3 Good (Poor costs 1, unrated 0.5, Fair 1/3, Good 0); average 0.21 x 15.

deductions.name: field_notes
deductions.reason: 0 open field-note flags on the control.

deductions.name: insufficient_data
deductions.reason: 7 field measurements in the last 12 months; 4 or more costs nothing, each one short costs 2.5.
